title: RepoMAS: Solving Progressively Specified Tasks with Issue-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.32490v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, but most assume that task requirements are sufficiently specified before execution. In practice, user requests are often incomplete, and additional requirements may only become clear during reasoning, tool use, or execution. We refer to such problems as progressively specified tasks.   To systematically study this setting, we introduce ProgSpec, a benchmark that evaluates final outputs against requirements explicitly stated in the initial request and additional requirements supported by the available task evidence. We further propose RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework inspired by open-source project management. RepoMAS records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues and uses them to revise the task specification and execution structure during problem solving. translated_title: RepoMAS：利用议题驱动的多智能体系统解决渐进式明确化任务
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）在解决复杂任务方面展现出强大潜力，但大多数系统假设任务需求在执行前已得到充分明确。在实际中，用户请求往往是不完整的，额外的需求可能只有在推理、工具使用或执行过程中才逐渐清晰。我们将这类问题称为渐进式明确化任务。为了系统地研究这一场景，我们提出了ProgSpec基准，该基准根据初始请求中明确陈述的需求以及可用任务证据所支持的额外需求来评估最终输出。我们进一步提出了RepoMAS，一个受开源项目管理启发的、由议题驱动的多智能体框架。RepoMAS将新发现的需求、冲突和失败记录为结构化的议题，并利用它们在问题解决过程中修订任务规范和执行结构。在ProgSpec和五个现有基准上……
tldr: 该论文提出了ProgSpec基准和RepoMAS框架，通过将任务解决过程中新发现的需求、冲突和失败记录为结构化议题并据此动态修订任务规范与执行结构，解决了任务需求渐进式明确化这一现实问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ProgSpec, a benchmark for progressively specified tasks, and RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework that records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues to dynamically revise task specifications and execution structures during problem solving.
